name: A Game Of Bat and Mouse
source:
The Hollowghast manor is a historical place run by a collector of important artifacts, anyone would dream of working there. You play as one of the newly hired maids, but you have a different mission. The lady of the house is a vampire, a child of the blood moon, she is your target. 

You’ve been tasked with framing her for a crime, whatever crime you can, so that she is executed. The thing is, what if the head maid is like this? A spy?

[From [url=https://corrocerous.itch.io/a-game-of-bat-and-mouse]itch.io[/url]]
